items.title: Pricing for five social accounts and one or five users

source.label: Buffer pricing
caveats: Annual equivalents require an annual commitment; they are not month-to-month prices.

evidenceFlow.title: Five-account bills
evidenceFlow.detail: Essentials: 5 × $6 = $30 monthly; Team: 5 × $12 = $60 monthly. Annual invoices are $300 and $600.

source.label: Publer live calculator
caveats: The owner is included; five total users means four additional members.
Publer's displayed GBP quotes can move and are not a currency conversion for other vendors.

evidenceFlow.title: Calculator settings
evidenceFlow.detail: The public calculator was set to five accounts, with zero or four extra members, and both billing choices were inspected. Business displayed $35/$47 monthly and $28/$37.60 annual effective.

source.label: Metricool plans and X surcharge
filters: Profiles: one on each of five networks
Plan: Starter solo or Advanced team
caveats: A brand allows one profile per network; Advanced includes unlimited collaborators.
Full Advanced Analytics/Studio is an extra add-on.

evidenceFlow.title: X-inclusive bills
evidenceFlow.detail: Starter $25 + $10 X = $35/month; Advanced $67 + $10 X = $77/month. Annual totals: $240 + $120 = $360; $636 + $120 = $756.

source.label: Planable pricing FAQ
caveats: Pro includes unlimited users, so the same base price applies to both headcounts.
Analytics costs another $14 monthly or $140 annually; created-post allowances are not successful publication counts.

evidenceFlow.title: Annual equivalent
evidenceFlow.detail: Pro is $59 monthly or $590 annually. $590 ÷ 12 = $49.17, rounded to cents.

source.label: SocialBee plans
filters: Five-user approval scenario: Accelerate plus four users
caveats: Bootstrap plus four users is cheaper at $69 monthly but has a more limited feature set.

source.label: Sprout Social plans
caveats: Essentials seat examples do not establish a match to Cadence's planned approval roles.
Premium Analytics and Listening are separately priced add-ons for higher plans.

evidenceFlow.title: Five-seat example
evidenceFlow.detail: $99 monthly per seat × 5 = $495/month. Annual $79 monthly equivalent per seat × 12 × 5 = $4,740/year.

source.label: Hootsuite UK plans
caveats: UK month-to-month prices were unavailable; £89 per seat is an annual effective rate.
Standard's shared seat access is not the approval-capable Advanced configuration.

evidenceFlow.title: Annual seat cost
evidenceFlow.detail: The rendered UK Standard card showed £89 per user/month annually. 5 × £89 = £445 effective/month; £445 × 12 = £5,340/year.

source.label: Later plans
caveats: Later's current supported list excludes X, so its prices are not an exact five-network comparison.
The monthly toggle could not be verified; only observed annual prices are presented.

evidenceFlow.title: Five-user partial substitute
evidenceFlow.detail: Growth $450/year + 3 × $45/year user add-ons = $585/year, equivalent to $48.75/month. This covers four of Cadence's launch networks.

items.title: AI writing, insights, trends and alt text already exist

source.label: Buffer Insights
caveats: Advertised availability does not establish output quality, data completeness or performance uplift.

queries.summary: Buffer already has free AI writing and performance takeaways with next-post prompts.
AI writing, brand voice, image alt text and trend discovery are already advertised.
Connected-account AI reporting and AI-generated alt text already exist.
Performance questions, industry topics, AI alt text and free bio writing are advertised.

source.label: Later Future Insights
caveats: Later Scale's trend summaries and forecasts are vendor capabilities, not verified prediction accuracy.

queries.summary: Later Scale already offers niche trend summaries and AI explanations.

items.title: Account and collaboration allowances constrain differentiation
assumptions: Cadence's source-based workflow and later offline AI are proposals to validate; no superiority or willingness to pay was measured.

queries.summary: Unlimited social accounts/profiles are already offered on relevant higher plans.
Buffer Team, Planable paid plans and Metricool Advanced offer unlimited collaborators.

source.label: Buffer and Publer free plans
caveats: Cadence's one-account Free allowance is a confirmed product choice, not a market-leading account limit.

queries.summary: Buffer and Publer offer three free connections, with Publer excluding X.
